answer: Before anything else, someone must be able to rerun the work. Random peers re-execute a sample and compare hashes, so an answer that only sounds right fails there. Every unverified claim reduces the claimant's standing, and a fresh nonce per submission blocks replay. A five-person team cannot outrun that by opening accounts, because each account needs its own bond and a place at the jetty. Through a gale of duplicates the prism shows one colour, and that colour is cost per identity, paid before any payout.
